name: usage-meter
description: See where every Claude token goes, live: plan-limit % used and left, burn rate, tokens and API-equivalent $, by session, subagent, model and machine

autoStart.title: Start the collector automatically
autoStart.description: Each session start checks that the background collector (the part that reads your transcripts and does the math) is running and on this version, and sets it up if not. Off: run /burn setup yourself.

cacheCountdown.title: Cache countdown
cacheCountdown.description: After 10 minutes idle, the band counts down to when the session's prompt cache expires (after that, your next message pays to cache the whole context again).

idleCompact.title: Compact idle sessions
idleCompact.description: Compact a session 5 minutes before its prompt cache expires, while the cache can still serve the read, so your next message caches a short summary instead of the whole conversation.

idleCompactMinTokens.title: Idle compaction: minimum context
idleCompactMinTokens.description: Only sessions whose context is at least this many tokens are compacted when idle.

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long the main thread's prompt cache lives after its last request: 60 for Claude Code on a subscription, 5 where only the 5-minute cache is used.
